subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw replace its documented single memory slot with this five-role, per-agent public contract, or evolve the existing capability APIs independently?
rationale: Implementation correctness cannot decide a permanent config and Plugin SDK taxonomy that conflicts with current VISION.md direction and overlaps an existing compaction capability.

options.title: Narrow to capability APIs
options.body: Keep recall as the exclusive memory selection, reuse the existing compaction and supplement seams, and introduce only role capabilities with fully defined invocation contracts.

options.title: Sponsor all five roles
options.body: Approve the proposed taxonomy, then require one canonical precedence model, Doctor migration, exact-head upgrade proof, and complete public SDK documentation before merge.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers design a different memory-composition contract and close or supersede this branch later.

recommendation.title: Narrow to capability APIs
recommendation.body: Keep recall as the exclusive memory selection, reuse the existing compaction and supplement seams, and introduce only role capabilities with fully defined invocation contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The central slot/config history and repository-level memory direction make this the strongest available decision owner.
